name: Starwell Archive
description: The oldest vault beneath Aurelia's museum, built around an imperial instrument that once charted the sky and now answers only to its own damaged calculations.

sealed_stair.name: Sealed Archive Stair
sealed_stair.description: A bronze door opens onto a narrow stair spiralling beneath the museum. Dust lies undisturbed on the upper steps, but pale starlight flickers from far below.

catalogue_gallery.name: Catalogue Gallery
catalogue_gallery.description: Stone shelves carry metal-bound catalogues whose labels have oxidised into unreadable green. The remaining filing mechanisms click without hands to operate them.

sealed_stacks.name: Sealed Stacks
sealed_stacks.description: Iron latticework encloses shelves of forbidden observations. Most volumes have crumbled to powder, but a few star charts still shine with ink that seems newly laid.

orrery_bridge.name: Orrery Bridge
orrery_bridge.description: A narrow bridge crosses a dry circular well beneath slowly revolving brass planets. Their motion is wrong by centuries, and every turn sends a quiet tremor through the stone.

starwell_chamber.name: Starwell Chamber
starwell_chamber.description: A shaft opens above a black mirror of water, reflecting a sky no one can see from Aurelia. At its rim an imperial guardian still interprets every visitor as an intrusion in the record.
